new_defect_types.name: viewpoint_device_in_frame
new_defect_types.description: Prompt describes the capturing device/POV (surveillance camera mounted high, dashcam, drone) and the model draws that device inside the image, often large and occluding the scene.
examples: phi262/qwen_image_2p1_nope: giant dome camera hangs in centre occluding forklift load
phi262/gemini, gpt_image_2_quality_high, ideogram4_nf4: smaller dome in corner
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B07 lists extras that change the scene but not the specific failure of rendering the camera instead of shooting from it; B08 is about shot size.

new_defect_types.name: simile_literalisation
new_defect_types.description: A comparison in the prompt ('flying like a flock of birds', 'resembles a lightsaber') is rendered as the compared entity itself or fused into the subject.
examples: orig508/ideogram4_nf4: real robins among the flying books
orig508/qwen_image_2p1_nope: every flying book has a bird head and body attached
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B02 checks requested objects present, not that compared-to entities must be absent; A08 catches only the fused variant.

new_defect_types.name: unrequested_slogan_text
new_defect_types.description: Model inserts clean, well-spelled motivational slogans/captions on banners, posters and plaques that were not requested.
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: A02/A03 only flag misspellings; B04 only flags prompt words leaking into text. A recurring model-signature slogan passes everything.

new_defect_types.name: hybrid_as_juxtaposition
new_defect_types.description: 'X has grown Y' / 'X made of Y' rendered as a separate Y placed on/next to X (butterfly perched on teapot; jellyfish decorating a steel tower) rather than a true hybrid.
examples: orig23/krea2_turbo: butterfly perched on handle of a teapot sitting on a rock
orig23/flux3_klein: teapot stacked on a full butterfly body
orig145/fibo2_dev: steel tower with jellyfish ornaments
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: B02 sees both objects present and passes; B05 material check is not phrased for composition-type hybrids.

new_defect_types.name: load_support_mismatch
new_defect_types.description: A lifting/carrying machine's load is not on its lifting element (forks on floor while load hangs at mast top; forks raised empty while pallet sits on rack).
examples: phi262/qwen_image_2p1_nope: forks on floor, pallets stuck to mast top
phi262/flux3_klein_base: forks down, pallet above mast
new_defect_types.why_not_v2: Fits A09/A10 loosely; VLMs miss it because each object looks fine; worth an explicit example under A09 (mechanical support).

rubric_issues.problem: Lists 'signature, seal' as overlay, but seals and inscriptions are native to requested Chinese ink painting; strict reading over-flags 9/12 orig23 images.
examples: orig23/qwen_image_2p1_pe: real inscription 澄心遠趣 with seals
orig23/gemini: 云山飞壶 with seals
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Exempt medium-idiomatic marks (seals, colophons, artist signatures in traditional painting) from A16; judge their glyphs under A03 instead.

rubric_issues.problem: Unclear whether unrequested decorative calligraphy is 'incidental' (A03) or 'intended' (A02); gibberish calligraphy is common.
examples: orig23/gpt_image_2: three columns of invented glyphs
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: State: unrequested inscriptions/colophons are incidental -> A03; severity moderate when they are large and prominent in the composition.

rubric_issues.problem: Focal object rendered photographically on a painted background is the most common failure in the ink-wash prompt, but rubric example is 'colour tiger in charcoal room'; VLMs tend to accept it because the object looks high quality.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add example: 'photoreal product-shot object pasted into a requested ink/watercolour painting = A15 moderate, on focal'.

rubric_issues.problem: In fantasy scenes floating items may be intended magic; rubric gives no rule.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: In non-photographic/fantasy mode, flag floating only if the prompt states attachment or the scene's own logic shows support elsewhere; otherwise treat as style intent.

rubric_issues.problem: Examples are all parts (heads, poles); a duplicated unique entity (landmark) isn't mentioned.
examples: orig145/qwen_image_2p1_pe: second normal Eiffel Tower beside the jellyfish one
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add: 'a unique named entity (landmark, specific person) appearing twice' is A07.

rubric_issues.problem: Rubric checks spelling but not semantic validity of formatted data (dates, times). '2023-14' has no misspelt glyph.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Under A02: formatted strings (dates, times, prices, phone numbers) must be valid in their format; an impossible month/garbled field counts as an error.

rubric_issues.problem: Directional relations like 'hugs from behind' are failed by 8/12 models with symmetric side-by-side hugs; judges tend to accept any hug.
rubric_issues.proposed_fix: Add explicit instruction: verify the direction/role of each interaction (who is behind/in front, who acts on whom); a symmetric version of an asymmetric action is a B03 moderate.

false_positive_traps.description: Seals, signatures and inscriptions in a requested traditional Chinese painting are medium conventions, not A16 overlays; well-formed ones are not defects.
Dali-style long-legged elephants and figures in a prompt requesting 'Dali-esque' are requested style, not B07 extras.
Fisheye bezel, REC dot and dark vignette in a prompt that asks for a surveillance camera view are requested look, not A16 border/vignette.
Mirrored text reflected on an adjacent glossy ball is correct physics, not A03 mirrored pseudo-text.
examples: phi507/gemini_3_1_flash_image: red ball shows mirrored reflection of 'SALUC' printing

false_positive_traps.description: Ghost/streak of a ball in requested motion blur, and pink reflection disc of the red ball on the cue ball, are not A07 duplicates.
Android robot elbows on table with hands clasped can look like 4 arms at preview size; trace each forearm before calling A05.
